newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Metway Bank's new name official next week.
newsitem.headline: Metway Bank's new name official next week.

text.p: Metway Bank Ltd said on Thursday that the name of its holding company will officially change to Suncorp-Metway Ltd on May 6.
The new name was approved by Metway Bank shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting in March following the merger of Metway with the Queensland government-owned Suncorp and QIDC.
The group's shares will be traded under the new name on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) from May 12 with a new ASX code of it said.
Chairman John Lamble said the new name signalled the strength and size of the merged group and confirmed its position as Queensland's largest provider of banking and insurance services.
